tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on CSI-2 Host controller
tables.text_helper: Table 369, "Effect of low-power modes on CSI-2 Host controller", in section 40.7 (CSI-2 Host low-power modes) on page 2034. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s).

rows: No effect. The CSI-2 host interrupts cause the device to exit the Sleep mode.
The CSI-2 host is in power-down, and must be reinitialized after exiting Stop mode.
The CSI-2 host is in power-down, and must be reinitialized after exiting Standby mode.
